user.title: Leapmotor (China) login
user.description: Choose an existing account to add another vehicle, or enter a phone number to receive an SMS code. Use a SECONDARY account for a new login.

vehicle.title: Select a vehicle
vehicle.description: Add one vehicle at a time. Vehicles already configured are excluded.

code.title: Enter SMS code
code.description:
A code was sent to {phone} and is **valid for 5 minutes**.

Expired or never arrived? Tick “Resend code” below and submit again.

error.invalid_auth: Wrong or expired code (valid 5 minutes). Tick “Resend code” and submit again.
error.risk_cooldown: Account flagged by risk control (1023). Wait 30+ minutes silently; retrying extends the cooldown
error.sms_too_often: SMS requested too often (36), retry in a few minutes
error.sms_failed: Failed to request SMS code, see logs
error.car_login_failed: Vehicle token exchange failed, see logs
error.no_vehicle: No vehicle on this account — make sure the car is shared with the secondary account
error.no_new_vehicle: This account has no vehicles that are not already configured
error.choose_account: Choose an existing account or enter a new phone number
error.account_unavailable: The selected account is no longer available
error.vehicle_unavailable: The selected vehicle is unavailable; reload the list
error.reauth_vehicle_missing: Authentication succeeded, but the original vehicle is missing from the account; its binding was preserved
error.reauth_account_mismatch: The reauthenticated account does not match this vehicle's original account
error.reauth_vehicle_mismatch: Reauthentication cannot change the vehicle binding

init.title: Leapmotor (China) options

data.operate_pwd: Vehicle operation PIN (4 digits, needed by sensitive commands)
data.launch_boost: Speed up polling when about to depart (unlock / power on)
data.car3d_color: 3D car paint (empty = as reported by the car)
data.energy_type: Energy type (controls whether fuel data is shown)

init.description:
Polling: 60 s parked, 6 s driving (same as the official app), and only the vehicle-state frame is fetched each round; mileage/energy/photo are fetched on demand.

Battery capacity is only used to turn SoC delta into kWh for trips.

Trip storage: {usage}. Tracks are kept per month; when the limit is exceeded the OLDEST months' tracks are cleared (trip records themselves are kept forever; 0 = unlimited).

data_description.battery_kwh: Used only to convert battery-% changes into kWh (trip energy / consumption). Enter the USABLE capacity, not the nominal (gross) pack size - they differ by a buffer (e.g. C10 RWD: 69.9 gross vs 67.0 usable). A wrong value scales every kWh figure.
data_description.trip_store_mb: Limits only the disk space used by TRACKS (stored per month). Trip records (time/distance/energy) are a plain-text ledger kept forever and cost almost nothing. 0 = unlimited.
data_description.car3d_color: Empty = colour reported by your car; or a colour name from the model's table / #RRGGBB for a custom one.
data_description.car3d_bg: auto = follow the dashboard theme; day = always day; night = always night. Only affects the 3D car scene.
data_description.car3d_image: https://… or /local/….png; empty = use the 3D model.
data_description.energy_type: Auto = decide from the car's own signals (fuel range > 0, or total range > EV range). Some BEVs report a bogus fuel percentage - pick "BEV" to hide fuel data; if a range-extender car is misdetected, pick "REEV".
data_description.amap_web_key: Web Service key, not a JavaScript key. Stored in HA; used only for manual place searches. Leave empty to disable.

error.invalid_amap_key: Enter a 32-character hexadecimal Web Service Key.
